Three.js 0.186.1 and its bundled Meshopt decoder, from the existing npm `three` package used by Tidal Reclaim. Bundled and minified with the project esbuild for the public GLB viewer, without source maps. Shader whitespace is normalized. Only renderer, camera/lights, GLTFLoader, OrbitControls and Meshopt exports used by blueprint-model.js are included. Original MIT license is retained in LICENSE; bundled legal comments are retained in viewer.js.LEGAL.txt. Original upstream sources: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r186 and https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer .
